purpose: Disposable local work index derived from current declarations and explicitly retained results, not a product registry or coverage promotion.
expectationSemantics: Counts derive from the existing shared contract. Core cells are not test-file, screenshot or appearance counts; extra inventory/boundary/domain scenes are excluded. Environment cells are required on Chromium by the shared contract, not inferred for Firefox/WebKit.
acceptanceRules: Specification/demo/test existence is not an automatic or visual pass.
currentDeclaredScopeMatch only compares captured/current docs/visual.json hashes, never whole current source or artifacts.
Retained candidates bind to their own immutable source/artifact identities; no current whole-worktree or cross-platform equivalence is inferred.
No baseline is established; no two consecutive ordinary pixel comparison runs are proved.
Final same-candidate complete unified Windows and local Linux entries remain pending for every product.
Historical default inventory never contributes to current state/size/environment matrix acceptance.
